# Azrienoch

The app's typeface. Source: https://github.com/HereLiesAz/azrienoch (commit `4eb009a`, version 1.0.0),
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). Azrienoch is a Modified Version of Jost.

`shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/azrienoch_{semibold,extrabold,black}.ttf` are static
instances of `fonts/variable/Azrienoch-VF.ttf` made with `fontTools.varLib.instancer` at
`wght` 400 / 600 / 800 / 900, `wdth` 100, `SERF` 0, `GRAD` 0.

Glyphs missing from Azrienoch (for example `_ ’ • › … $ ^ |`) render in the system font.
